_comment: Historical events of the 4th Era that heavily impact Skyrim and Tamriel.
These are logged as exact historical days rather than repeating holidays.
Install alongside 10_Vanilla.json and 20_Provinces.json for a complete calendar.
Events without a strict canon calendar day have been assigned lore-friendly dates.

events.name: The Red Year
events.description: The cataclysmic eruption of Red Mountain destroys much of Vvardenfell. Thousands of Dunmer refugees flee into Skyrim, eventually establishing settlements like Windhelm's Gray Quarter.

events.name: Return of the Moons
events.description: The moons Masser and Secunda return to the night sky after a terrifying two-year absence. The Thalmor take credit for ending the Void Nights, manipulating Elsweyr into joining the Dominion.

events.name: The Great Collapse
events.description: Catastrophic year-long storms tear away the cliffs of the ancient capital, sending most of Winterhold crashing into the Sea of Ghosts. Only the College of Winterhold remains largely untouched.

events.name: The Ultimatum
events.description: The Thalmor ambassador delivers the Aldmeri Dominion's extreme demands to Emperor Titus Mede II. The Emperor's refusal marks the official beginning of the Great War.

events.name: Sack of the Imperial City
events.description: The Aldmeri Dominion breaches the walls of the Imperial City, leading to widespread slaughter and forcing the Imperial army to retreat into Skyrim and Hammerfell.

events.name: Battle of the Red Ring
events.description: The Imperial Army, heavily reinforced by Skyrim's legions, decimates the main Aldmeri force in Cyrodiil and retakes the capital. It is the Empire's greatest victory in the war.

events.name: The White-Gold Concordat
events.description: The White-Gold Concordat is signed, officially ending the Great War. The treaty outlaws Talos worship across the Empire and disbands the Blades.

events.name: The Markarth Incident
events.description: Ulfric Stormcloak and his militia successfully reclaim Markarth from the Forsworn. The subsequent arrest of Ulfric over Talos worship plants the seeds of the rebellion.

events.name: Death of High King Torygg
events.description: Ulfric Stormcloak challenges and kills High King Torygg in Solitude using the Thu'um. The violent event shatters the province and plunges Skyrim into open civil war.

events.name: Capture of Ulfric Stormcloak
events.description: Imperial forces under General Tullius ambush and capture Ulfric Stormcloak at Darkwater Crossing. The prisoners are bound for execution in Helgen, seemingly bringing an end to the rebellion.
